title: McMurtry Speirling BREAKS Goodwood Hillclimb Record!! 39.08!
summary: Coverage of the McMurtry Speirling fan car breaking the Goodwood hillclimb record with a 39.08 second run driven by Max Chilton. It beat the Volkswagen ID.R and the 1999 McLaren time.
why: Shared as a striking example of a fan car using powered ground effect, with an eye-popping launch, in EV and motorsport threads.

quote.text: Take a look at the Speirling at Goodwood Festival of Speed for an awfully mean fan car.
